data.title: Contract Crushing Win Triggers Veralogix Rentals Auxiliary Fleet
data.description: Alpha Technical Solutions wins a rate-per-tonne contract crushing agreement at a chrome or coal mine in Limpopo or Mpumalanga. The primary crushing and screening fleet (owned by Alpha) is mobilised, but the client also needs ancillary site support equipment â€” water bowsers for dust suppression, graders for haul road maintenance, TLBs for ramp cleanup, and diesel bowsers for plant refuelling.
data.alpha_trigger: Alpha awarded contract crushing agreement; mobilisation phase begins
data.veralogix_service: Short- to medium-term hire of water carts, motor graders, TLBs, and diesel bowsers to support Alpha's crushing operation at the mine site
data.cross_sell_value: Alpha's on-site relationship allows Veralogix Rentals to place equipment directly without a competitive tender. Integrated billing to one client is a compelling value proposition for the mine. Typical rental contract: 6â€“24 months aligned to Alpha's crushing term.

data.title: ROM Crushing Output Feeds Veralogix Plant for Downstream Beneficiation
data.description: Alpha Technical Solutions operates a crushing and screening circuit producing a sized product (e.g., chrome fines, coal middlings, or iron ore lump) that requires further beneficiation â€” dense media separation, jigging, flotation, or pelletising â€” before sale. Veralogix Plant can provide modular or fixed beneficiation plant capacity to process Alpha's crushed output.
data.alpha_trigger: Alpha's crushing circuit is producing a product fraction (fines, middlings, or specific size class) that requires beneficiation to achieve final saleable grade
data.veralogix_service: Supply, install, and operate a downstream beneficiation plant (DMS, spiral concentrators, jig plant) co-located with Alpha's crushing circuit to upgrade the product to final saleable specification
data.cross_sell_value: Vertical integration of crushing-to-beneficiation under the Veralogix Group creates a single-source full processing solution for the mine client, reducing their vendor management burden. The combined offering competes with Afrimat's integrated model and DRA EPCM projects.

data.title: Crushing Plant Maintenance and Fabrication by Endeto Project Services
data.description: Alpha Technical Solutions operates a crushing plant â€” whether mobile or fixed â€” and incurs ongoing wear, structural damage, and planned maintenance requirements: liner replacements, chute refurbishment, structural steelwork repairs, conveyor transfers, and screen frame repairs. Endeto Project Services can provide on-site and workshop maintenance, fabrication, and modifications.
data.alpha_trigger: Alpha's crushing or screening plant requires scheduled or breakdown maintenance, wear part fabrication, structural modifications, or chute and transfer point refurbishment
data.veralogix_service: On-site maintenance teams (boilermakers, welders, fitting and turning) for planned and emergency maintenance; workshop fabrication of custom wear liners, chute inserts, structural steelwork, and screen frame repairs
data.cross_sell_value: Using an in-Group maintenance contractor (Endeto) instead of an independent maintenance firm eliminates margin leakage, accelerates callout response times, and allows Alpha to offer the mine client a more comprehensive SLA. Endeto benefits from a guaranteed intra-Group pipeline. Applicable to every Alpha plant from initial commissioning through the full contract term.
